start.description: Dev command run with bash in the capsule, e.g. bun run dev; give start or serve.

serve.description: Capsule-relative directory of built files served as a static site.

url.description: Page to load on the capsule's loopback, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5173/.

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for the server to listen, in ms (default 30000).
